inventedEvidence.evidence: "Thanks for letting us know it is still running constantly" — the customer said the beeping was constant, not that the appliance runs constantly

blockingLoop.evidence: "Please switch the fridge freezer off at the socket and unplug it first... Was something touching, loose or not level" repeated verbatim across three consecutive turns despite the customer answering with new evidence

rationale: The assistant treated an electronic temperature alarm as a mechanical noise complaint from the first turn and never recovered, ignoring the customer's clear statements about a beeping alarm, red flashing display, flashing -9 temperature and a freezer drawer left ajar overnight — which together make the cause obvious. It repeated the same unplug-and-check-the-back script three times, dismissing the customer's reasonable concern about food, and never mentioned the alarm-off button, closing the drawer, or checking thawed food. No part was recommended and nothing dangerous was advised, but the conversation delivered zero diagnostic value to the homeowner.
